property.name: maximum_parameter_sql
property.value: SELECT ceri_score_snapshots.id, ceri_score_snapshots.evidence_id, ceri_score_snapshots.controlled_replay_id, ceri_score_snapshots.run_id, ceri_score_snapshots.source_run_id_text, ceri_score_snapshots.company_id, ceri_score_snapshots.ticker, ceri_score_snapshots.as_of_session, ceri_score_snapshots.cutoff_at, ceri_score_snapshots.calculation_context_id, ceri_score_snapshots.calendar_version, ceri_score_snapshots.opportunity_score, ceri_score_snapshots.opportunity_coverage_pct, ceri_score_snapshots.opportunity_unrated_reason, ceri_score_snapshots.event_risk_score, ceri_score_snapshots.data_confidence, ceri_score_snapshots.coverage_pct, ceri_score_snapshots.posture, ceri_score_snapshots.earnings_proximity_risk, ceri_score_snapshots.alignment_flags_json, ceri_score_snapshots.alignment_context_json, ceri_score_snapshots.evidence_lineage_json, ceri_score_snapshots.top_positive_contributors_json, ceri_score_snapshots.top_negative_contributors_json, ceri_score_snapshots.component_json, ceri_score_snapshots.opportunity_ledger_json, ceri_score_snapshots.confidence_ledger_json, ceri_score_snapshots.event_risk_ledger_json, ceri_score_snapshots.reasons_json, ceri_score_snapshots.warnings_json, ceri_score_snapshots.config_version, ceri_score_snapshots.config_hash, ceri_score_snapshots.calculation_version, ceri_score_snapshots.evidence_contract_version, ceri_score_snapshots.comparison_state, ceri_score_snapshots.comparison_snapshot_id, ceri_score_snapshots.evidence_hash, ceri_score_snapshots.hash_schema_version, ceri_score_snapshots.created_at FROM ceri_score_snapshots LEFT OUTER JOIN (SELECT DISTINCT ON (ceri_evidence_dispositions.ceri_snapshot_id) ceri_evidence_dispositions.ceri_snapshot_id AS ceri_snapshot_id, ceri_evidence_dispositions.disposition AS disposition, ceri_evidence_dispositions.reason_code AS reason_code FROM ceri_evidence_dispositions ORDER BY ceri_evidence_dispositions.ceri_snapshot_id, ceri_evidence_dispositions.created_at DESC, ceri_evidence_dispositions.id DESC) AS anon_1 ON anon_1.ceri_snapshot_id = ceri_score_snapshots.id WHERE coalesce(anon_1.disposition, %(coalesce_1)s::VARCHAR) = %(coalesce_2)s::VARCHAR AND (ceri_score_snapshots.calculation_context_id IS NULL AND NOT (EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM pipeline_runs AS pipeline_runs_1 WHERE pipeline_runs_1.upload_run_id = ceri_score_snapshots.run_id AND (pipeline_runs_1.status IN (%(status_1_1)s::VARCHAR, %(status_1_2)s::VARCHAR, %(status_1_3)s::VARCHAR) OR pipeline_runs_1.status = %(status_2)s::VARCHAR AND NOT (pipeline_runs_1.status = %(status_3)s::VARCHAR AND coalesce(((pipeline_runs_1.result_json[%(result_json_1)s::TEXT]) ->> %(param_1)s::TEXT) = %(param_2)s::VARCHAR, %(coalesce_3)s) AND coalesce(((pipeline_runs_1.result_json[%(result_json_1)s::TEXT][%(param_3)s::TEXT]) ->> %(param_4)s::TEXT) = %(param_5)s::VARCHAR, %(coalesce_4)s))))) OR (EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM market_calculation_contexts LEFT OUTER JOIN pipeline_runs ON pipeline_runs.id = market_calculation_contexts.pipeline_run_id WHERE market_calculation_contexts.id = ceri_score_snapshots.calculation_context_id AND (market_calculation_contexts.pipeline_run_id IS NULL AND NOT (EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM pipeline_runs AS pipeline_runs_1, ceri_score_snapshots WHERE pipeline_runs_1.upload_run_id = ceri_score_snapshots.run_id AND (pipeline_runs_1.status IN (%(status_1_1)s::VARCHAR, %(status_1_2)s::VARCHAR, %(status_1_3)s::VARCHAR) OR pipeline_runs_1.status = %(status_2)s::VARCHAR AND NOT (pipeline_runs_1.status = %(status_3)s::VARCHAR AND coalesce(((pipeline_runs_1.result_json[%(result_json_1)s::TEXT]) ->> %(param_1)s::TEXT) = %(param_2)s::VARCHAR, %(coalesce_3)s) AND coalesce(((pipeline_runs_1.result_json[%(result_json_1)s::TEXT][%(param_3)s::TEXT]) ->> %(param_4)s::TEXT) = %(param_5)s::VARCHAR, %(coalesce_4)s))))) OR NOT (pipeline_runs.status IN (%(status_4_1)s::VARCHAR, %(status_4_2)s::VARCHAR, %(status_4_3)s::VARCHAR) OR pipeline_runs.status = %(status_5)s::VARCHAR AND NOT (pipeline_runs.status = %(status_6)s::VARCHAR AND coalesce(((pipeline_runs.result_json[%(result_json_2)s::TEXT]) ->> %(param_6)s::TEXT) = %(param_7)s::VARCHAR, %(coalesce_5)s) AND coalesce(((pipeline_runs.result_json[%(result_json_2)s::TEXT][%(param_8)s::TEXT]) ->> %(param_9)s::TEXT) = %(param_10)s::VARCHAR, %(coalesce_6)s))))))) AND ceri_score_snapshots.company_id IN (%(company_id_1_1)s::BIGINT, %(company_id_1_2)s::BIGINT) AND ceri_score_snapshots.as_of_session <= %(as_of_session_1)s::DATE AND ceri_score_snapshots.cutoff_at <= %(cutoff_at_1)s::TIMESTAMP WITH TIME ZONE AND ceri_score_snapshots.run_id = %(run_id_1)s::BIGINT
